notes.title: Scribble Ships 1.01 Patch
notes.notes:
A patch has been released to address a few small bugs.

+ A crash relating to one of the bosses has been fixed
+ Rockets and bullets have been optimized to improve performance
+ Have a shield no longer makes you invincible against "The Orb" boss
+ "The Leviathan" boss will no longer inflict damage just after being destroyed

Thanks to all that are enjoying the game!

Slothzilla Games
